title: Soft but not what I expected
text: Soft but not what I expected. Undoubtedly soft but a little disappointing because it seems like it does not have enough fill inside.  I have bought other brands for my cat and they seem more sturdy while being just as soft.  I purchased this for my dog and he doesn’t want to have anything to do with it and I am wondering if it is because of the fill.
